_conventions: One issue per finding. status: open|in-progress|fixed|deferred|wont-fix. Closing REQUIRES resolution (root cause + fix location). Flip statuses as work lands, not in an end sweep. source: where the finding came from. round: product-pass-2026-07-07 for this seeding.

issues.title: Daemon crash mid-task orphans the task in in_progress forever
issues.detail: Stale-requeue sweeps only cover status 'assigned' (tasks.ts:2715,2753) and stale-phase (tasks.ts:2837); nothing reclaims 'in_progress'. /tasks/:id/fail requires the original claiming device. Daemon dead-worker detection lives in the in-memory activeInstances map, lost on restart; pollForPendingTasks only re-claims pending_agent/assigned (daemon.ts:410-414). No heartbeat, lease, or server-side in_progress timeout exists. Task is stuck until a human cancels/retries.
issues.resolution: Lease/heartbeat/reclaim per docs/design/m3-reliability.md. Hub: migration 0018_task_lease (lease_expires_at, reclaim_count, tasks_lease_idx, backfill), claim sets lease atomically, POST /tasks/:id/heartbeat (policy task:heartbeat, 409 lease_lost), exported sweepExpiredLeases + setInterval wiring (FORGE_HUB_RECLAIM_SWEEP_SECONDS, 0 disables) requeuing expired in_progress to assigned/pending_agent, failing over FORGE_HUB_TASK_MAX_RECLAIMS with lease_expired_max_reclaims, phase tasks route through blocked-root bookkeeping. Daemon: heartbeat interval (FORGE_DAEMON_HEARTBEAT_MS) beats active real tasks, on 409/404 kills local instance without failTask. Tests: tasks.test.ts heartbeat + sweepExpiredLeases suites, migrate.test.ts 0018 suite, m3-reliability.test.ts heartbeat suite.

issues.title: FM front-door routing broken: workspace-created tasks skip dispatcher triage
issues.detail: The comment at forge-hub/src/routes/tasks.ts:1793-1799 says tasks created without an explicit agent go to the dispatcher inbox (pending_dispatcher_action) so FM triages them. The code at line 1800 contradicts it: initialStatus = !allDepsDone ? 'waiting_on_deps' : 'pending_agent'. Result: every dashboard-created task lands directly in the claimable pool; any worker races to claim it with its default personality (architect), bypassing FM triage entirely. Verified live in the product-pass smoke run: worker claimed the task the same second it was created; FM never triaged. Fix: unassigned -> 'pending_dispatcher_action', pre-assigned -> 'pending_agent'. Failing-first test.
issues.resolution: pending_agent hardcode at the plain workspace create; fixed in forge-hub tasks.ts:1884-1889 (unassigned -> pending_dispatcher_action) and both dep-release branches (tasks.ts:360,459). Tests: issue-2 create test, D02, D05, D02b. Verified live: mone-001 started in the FM inbox.

issues.title: Successful agent marked failed: done-file instruction uses relative path for non-repo-bound tasks
issues.detail: daemon.ts:934 sets donePath to the RELATIVE '.forge/tasks/{id}.done' when the daemon is not repo-bound (repo-bound branch at :945 correctly uses an absolute path). Reproduced 3x (twice in the live pipeline, once via BackgroundRuntime directly): a task description saying 'at the repository root' makes the agent resolve the root to the PARENT directory (G:/dev, which has .claude/CLAUDE.md markers) and do ALL work there, including the relative done file; the workdir-scoped done-watcher never sees it and the daemon marks the successful run 'agent exited without completing' -> failed. Control prompts without 'repository root' resolved correctly 4/4, so the trigger is prompt ambiguity, but the vulnerability is the relative donePath. Fix: (1) always pass absolute donePath in the done instruction; (2) prepend to initialPrompt: 'Your working directory and project root is exactly <absolute workdir>; do all work under it.'
issues.resolution: Relative donePath + no workdir statement in prompt; fixed in forge-daemon daemon.ts:1014 (absolute donePath always) + working-directory preamble at daemon.ts:1058-1067. Tests in daemon-dispatch-fixes.test.ts + integration.test.ts. Verified live with adversarial repository-root phrasing: artifact and done file landed in the workdir.

issues.title: Hung agent has no wall-clock timeout; alive-but-stuck process holds a slot forever
issues.detail: isAlive is purely file-based (background.ts:266-294); the done-file watcher (sync/task-file.ts:158-182) has no timer; there is no per-task max runtime. A hung-but-alive process yields isAlive()=true forever and the task never fails. Only manual stop instructions kill it. Fix: record startedAt per active instance and kill/fail tasks exceeding a configurable max runtime.
issues.resolution: ActiveInstance.startedAt + FORGE_DAEMON_MAX_TASK_RUNTIME_MS (default 60min, 0 disables) checked in pollForPendingTasks before isAlive; handleRuntimeTimeout stops the runtime, fails real tasks through the bounded retry helper, resets fmRunning/cooldown for FM synthetics; done-file-at-boundary race guarded (completed task not killed). Tests: m3-reliability.test.ts timeout suite.

issues.title: OPS-1: Heimdall Phase 3 enforcement incomplete (~13 of 18 VALID_ACTIONS unenforced)
issues.detail: policy-rules.ts declares ~18 VALID_ACTIONS but only task:claim, task:assign, doc:write, device:deregister, device:rotate-token have checkPolicy call sites. task:cancel/retry/complete/fail, doc:update/supersede/archive, context:read, workspace:list can be authored as rules but nothing enforces them. Wire checkPolicy at every declared action; built-in defaults must preserve current behavior. Failing-first test per action. (From HANDOFF section 3, OPS-1.)
issues.resolution: Shipped remotely as PR #131 (paperclip-scs bot, merged 2026-06-21, commit e58b9a8): checkPolicy wired for task:cancel/retry/complete/fail, task:assign, doc:update/supersede/archive, context:read, workspace:list. Product-pass reconciliation added builtin_orchestrator_task_fail_allow so the issue-44 quarantine path survives the new task:fail enforcement (policy/defaults.ts).

issues.title: OPS-2: pin daemon model to sonnet in code (unset env falls through to CLI default)
issues.detail: claude-code.ts and background.ts omit --model when config.model is unset, letting the CLI default decide (the $95 Opus runaway failure mode). Compose pins FORGE_DAEMON_MODEL but code has no safe default. Add sonnet default in code. Failing-first test proving unset env no longer omits --model. (From HANDOFF OPS-2.)
issues.resolution: Shipped remotely as PR #129 (paperclip-scs bot, merged 2026-06-21, commit 691c901): unset FORGE_DAEMON_MODEL now defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6 in code; --model is always passed.

issues.title: OPS-3: remove stale shared-OAuth retry logic in daemon
issues.detail: daemon.ts still carries authRetryLimit / AUTH_FAILURE_RE machinery and comments describing shared OAuth token rotation. Auth model is per-container ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Keep genuine API-key 401 retry; delete shared-home assumptions. (From HANDOFF OPS-3.)
issues.resolution: Shipped remotely as PR #130 (paperclip-scs bot, merged 2026-06-21, commit 3e585b3): shared-OAuth rotation comments and machinery removed; genuine API-key 401 retry kept.

issues.title: Agent transcript invisible: --print captures only final text, no tool activity
issues.detail: BackgroundRuntime pipes stdout/stderr of 'claude --print' to the log file, which contains only the final response text. When the smoke agent went wrong there was zero visibility into what it actually did (which commands, which paths). Fix options: use --output-format stream-json (or --verbose) and store structured transcript; surface it in the dash agent-output panel.

issues.title: Dash live agent output reads local files; broken in any split deployment
issues.detail: /api/agents/[taskId]/stream tails ${FORGE_WORKDIR}/context/agent-logs/{taskId}.log and watches .forge done files on the DASH host. Only works when dash is co-located with the daemon. In the production accserver topology (containers) and any remote setup the panel silently shows 'Waiting for output...'. Fix: ship agent output through the hub (append endpoint + SSE), not the local fs.

issues.title: No cost/token telemetry anywhere; Costs page spend section is a hardcoded placeholder
issues.detail: The $95 Opus incident happened partly because spend is invisible. Costs page shows budgets only; 'Requires forge-daemon v2+' placeholder for actual spend. claude --print supports usage reporting (stream-json includes usage); daemon could report tokens per task to the hub; hub aggregates per agent/workspace/day. This closes the loop with the never-shipped token-budget guardrail prototype (_vibe-forge attention/token-budget-scribe.md).

issues.title: FM dispatcher daemon's worker loop tries to claim tasks and spams policy_denied
issues.detail: In dispatcher mode the daemon still runs its worker poll loop; it attempted to claim smoke-001 and got 403 policy_denied (role:orchestrator). Heimdall correctly blocked it, but the orchestrator should not be claiming at all - noise in logs, races with real workers, and one ERROR line per pending task per poll. Fix: disable the worker claim loop when dispatcherMode=true (or make claim-eligibility status-aware).

issues.title: Worker agentId silently defaults to 'architect' when FORGE_DAEMON_AGENT_ID unset
issues.detail: config.ts defaults defaultAgentId to architect; an unscoped worker spawns the architect personality for any unassigned task it claims. Silent and surprising. Should either require explicit agentId, or log prominently, or (with issue 2 fixed) only claim tasks whose assignedAgentId matches.
issues.resolution: Silent architect fallback; config.ts now exposes defaultAgentIdWasDefaulted and daemon.ts:324-327 logs a prominent worker-mode startup warning. Tests in config.test.ts + daemon-dispatch-fixes.test.ts.

issues.title: Failed tasks create no follow-up signal; failure is silent unless you look
issues.detail: smoke-001 failed with reason 'agent exited without completing'; no dispatcher comment, no human-attention task, no notification. For a daily-driver product a failed dispatch should surface: FM triage of failures (retry vs escalate) or at minimum a pending_dispatcher_action follow-up.

issues.title: Terminal-state hub calls (complete/fail) have no retry; done work can be silently lost
issues.detail: completeTask/failTask failures are logged and dropped (daemon.ts:1186-1191, :993-1000); local files already cleaned. A transient 5xx at completion strands the task in_progress with the work done. Add bounded retry with backoff and defer local cleanup until hub confirms.
issues.resolution: retryTerminal helper in daemon.ts: bounded exponential backoff (1s/5s/15s/60s, FORGE_DAEMON_TERMINAL_RETRY_LIMIT default 4), retries only network/429/5xx via new HttpError; 4xx stops retries and cleans local state. handleTaskDone completes first, cleanupTaskFiles/map-delete only after confirmed 2xx; exhaustion keeps done file and poll loop re-enters handleTaskDone each tick (completingTaskIds dedup guard prevents watcher/poll double-fire). Hub idempotency verified by tests: complete-on-completed / fail-on-failed benign non-5xx, no duplicate history. Tests: m3-reliability.test.ts retry suite, tasks.test.ts idempotency suite.

issues.title: Hub default DATABASE_URL is :memory:; unset env in prod loses everything on restart
issues.detail: config.ts:7 defaults databaseUrl to ':memory:'. Fail fast (or warn loudly) when running with an in-memory DB outside tests. Also document: EventBus is in-process only, events in flight during restart are dropped, poll loop is the durability backstop.
issues.resolution: assertDatabaseSafety in app.ts createHub: throws in NODE_ENV=production when databaseUrl is :memory: unless FORGE_HUB_ALLOW_MEMORY_DB=1; loud fastify.log warning outside production. Tests: app.test.ts issue-15 suite (4 tests).

issues.title: One malformed personality file silently disables ALL composed prompts
issues.detail: loadPersonalitiesFromDir throws on first bad file; forge-daemon catches and continues with personalityRegistry=undefined, so every agent gets the generic fallback string. Load per-file with try/catch, skip+log the bad file, keep the rest.

issues.title: skip-permissions defaults ON; preferredTools/runtimeHints consumed nowhere; daemon heimdall/proxy.ts is dead code
issues.detail: Config defaults skipPermissions=true; personalities' read-only posture (aegis/oracle/architect/loki) is honor-system. preferredTools and runtimeHints are schema-declared but never consumed. The daemon filesystem sandbox (heimdall/proxy.ts checkOperation/createPolicy) is exported but never invoked - dead code implying a sandbox that does not exist. Either wire runtimeHints to --allowedTools at spawn and invoke checkOperation, or delete the proxy and document the trust model honestly.

issues.title: Device tokens are immortal; WS handshake puts token in URL query string
issues.detail: devices table has no expiresAt; rotation is manual only. hub-client.ts:113-114 sends ?token=... on the WS handshake, which lands in proxy/access logs (HTTP path correctly uses Authorization header). Add expiry+rotation policy; move WS auth to header/subprotocol or short-lived ticket.

issues.title: Staff or formally drop ember (DevOps) and pixel (UX) roles
issues.detail: Live personalities still hand work toward them: flux remediation routes to ember, slag report template lists ember as fixer; red-team remediation dead-ends. Port from prototype with current conventions (temper.md as template) or sweep dangling references from slag.md/flux.md. Porting ember is higher-value. forge-master.md now escalates unstaffed roles (fixed in once-over) but the dangling references remain.

issues.title: FM/dispatcher spawn path missing handoff/taskContext compose layers
issues.detail: Worker spawn passes handoffDir+taskContext (daemon.ts:906-912) - the once-over claim that neither is passed is stale for workers. The FM path (daemon.ts:738-742) passes only projectContextPath+agentOverridesDir. Decide: FM should see handoffs (pass them) or document the omission as intentional.

issues.detail: Three overlapping definitions: live personalities/ (13), _vibe-forge/config/agents.json (16, stale 'single source of truth'), agent-manifest.yaml (stale since Jan). Runbook PM2 config lists 9. README says 'and more'. Generate roster docs from loadBuiltinRegistry(); add deprecation README in _vibe-forge/config/; archive or fix the prototype /forge command that names a never-existing 'sentinel' reviewer.

issues.detail: Red-team engagements are multi-session; add the same memory convention as workers with the 'locations, never vulnerable values' caveat (same as added to aegis in the once-over).

issues.title: Add own-scope exit criterion sentence to worker personalities
issues.detail: Agents in concurrent multi-agent work should never gate exit on whole-tree state (green build, stable queue). One sentence per worker personality: 'your exit criterion is your own scope verified + done file written, never whole-tree green.'

issues.title: Live agent-instances API entirely unsurfaced in dash; progress bars are fake

LeftRail and agent-detail 'current work' bars are hardcoded width:45% animate-pulse. Surface real instance state; remove fake bars until real progress exists.

issues.title: Dash task detail uses flat history/comments endpoints that may 401 for session users
issues.detail: tasks/[taskId]/page.tsx fetches /tasks/:id/history and /tasks/:id/comments (device-oriented auth) instead of workspace-scoped variants; in-code comments warn they may return empty/401 for cookie users. Verify and switch to workspace-scoped endpoints.

issues.title: Onboarding friction: POST /workspaces rejects repoUrl:null with 422
issues.detail: Schema requires string-or-omit (exactOptionalPropertyTypes style). A null from any client is a confusing 422. Accept null as omit at the boundary (Zod .nullish() -> undefined) for optional fields on public creation endpoints.
issues.resolution: Root cause: CreateWorkspaceInputSchema required string-or-omit, so repoUrl:null 422d. Fix: local CreateWorkspaceBodySchema in forge-hub routes/workspaces.ts treats null as omit (nullishToUndefined) for description/repoUrl/repoBranch; same pattern applied to CreateGoalSchema description/parentId in routes/goals.ts. Shared forge-core schema untouched. Tests: workspaces.test.ts POST /workspaces accepts repoUrl:null as omit; goals.test.ts POST accepts description:null and parentId:null as omit. Other creation endpoints audited: tasks/devices/workspace-patch already nullable; comments.authorId, agent-instances.runtimeInstanceId, invites, agents.config deliberately skipped (see issue 51).

issues.title: No fresh-machine quickstart doc; two contradictory deployment models documented
issues.detail: PM2 runbook (production-deployment.md, hub.local hostname) vs compose/CD reality (daemons.compose.yml, lab.local, Traefik). project-context.md is badly stale (claims Phase 1, 28 tests, personalities as stubs). No single 'clone -> first dispatched task' walkthrough exists; the product-pass boot required reading source to discover env vars, device registration, dispatcher mode. Write docs/QUICKSTART.md validated on a clean machine; mark the PM2 runbook superseded; refresh project-context.md.
issues.resolution: Wrote docs/QUICKSTART.md (clone -> first dispatched task, sourced from smoke skill and cross-checked against code, worker registered WITH agentId). Added superseded banner to docs/runbooks/production-deployment.md (PM2 model retired, points to compose/CD reality and QUICKSTART). Refreshed context/project-context.md (note: lives in context/, not docs/) including a wrong claim: FORGE_DAEMON_DEFAULT_RUNTIME defaults to background, not mock (config.ts:10). Also fixed stale smoke skill steps 3 and 6 (issue-2 workaround removed, worker agentId added). Pending live validation walk by verifier.

issues.detail: 'Heimdall' names both the wired hub policy engine and the unwired daemon heimdall/proxy.ts. The 'Heimdall pre-flight' comment in tasks.ts:765 invites false confidence that agent file access is sandboxed. Rename one; wire or delete the proxy (overlaps issue 17).

issues.detail: Feature flag exists in tasks.ts; commit a242a1c enabled it in the production hub env file - verify it is actually live on accserver (docker exec env check) and close.

issues.title: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / auth-source env leaks into locally spawned agents
issues.detail: Spawned claude warned 'connectors are disabled because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or another auth source is set' - BackgroundRuntime passes the daemon's full process.env to agents. Locally that leaked the parent session's auth env; in prod it is intended (per-container key). Consider an env allowlist for spawned agents instead of full inheritance.

issues.title: Onboarding dead-end: nothing registers workspace agents; FM cannot route until manual POST /workspaces/:id/agents
issues.detail: Fresh workspace has an empty agents table; the 13 built-in personalities are never registered anywhere. FM triage correctly defers ('no agents registered in workspace') cycle after cycle, burning an FM spawn each time, until someone manually curls POST /workspaces/:id/agents (no dash UI for this - dashboard-audit found agent CRUD has no front door). After 3 deferrals the task is quarantined. Fix: seed workspace agents from loadBuiltinRegistry() at workspace creation (or a one-click 'register standard roster' action + dash UI).
issues.resolution: No agent seeding at workspace creation; fixed via DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_AGENT_ROSTER in forge-core types/agent.ts + seeding in forge-hub workspaces.ts:66-74. Test: POST /workspaces seeds the default agent roster. Verified live: fresh workspace returned 9 agents.

issues.title: FM quarantine fail-path calls /tasks/:id/fail on a non-in_progress task -> 409, task stuck in limbo
issues.detail: After 3 triage deferrals the dispatcher quarantines the task and tries POST /tasks/:id/fail, which requires in_progress; a pending_dispatcher_action task 409s ('not_in_progress'), so quarantine neither fails the task nor creates a human-attention signal - it just stops triaging (in-memory attempt counter; daemon restart resets it). Fix: quarantine should use a status transition that exists for inbox tasks (e.g. blocked with blockedReason, or a dedicated escalation task), with a hub-side test.
issues.resolution: Hub fail endpoint required in_progress + claiming device; DEVICE_FAILABLE_STATUSES added (tasks.ts:103) so orchestrator devices can fail pending_dispatcher_action tasks (tasks.ts:2524-2580); daemon quarantine reason now fm_quarantine with log-once (daemon.ts:739-742). Tests both sides.

issues.title: Agent identifier domains inconsistent: FM assigned the workspace-agent ROW ID; workers identify by personality name; assign endpoint validates nothing
issues.detail: PATCH /tasks/:id/assign stores body.agentId verbatim (tasks.ts:~908,:987) - no validation that any daemon identifies as it. Workspace agents are nanoid rows (name=furnace, id=rnDR...); daemons claim with FORGE_DAEMON_AGENT_ID (personality names). In the smoke run FM (an LLM reading workspace context) passed the row id; the furnace-named assignment became unclaimable by any worker and sat in 'assigned' until the 30-min stale sweep would requeue it. Same dispatch worked when a human reassigned by name. Fix: pick ONE identifier domain (personality name is what daemons use), have the assign endpoint resolve/validate against registered workspace agents + live device agentIds, and make FM's instructions explicit about which field to use.
issues.resolution: Assign stored body.agentId verbatim; resolveAssignAgentId (tasks.ts:266) resolves workspace-agent row IDs to names, validates names/device agentIds, 422 unknown_agent otherwise; wired into device (tasks.ts:967) and user (tasks.ts:1062) paths. Verified live: FM routed by name (scribe).

issues.title: Worker claim loop hammers not_claimable tasks every 5s forever - the May runaway loop is still live in the worker path
issues.detail: When a task is assigned/visible but not claimable by this device, the worker retries POST /tasks/:id/claim every poll (5s) with no backoff, no give-up, one ERROR log line each. Observed live: ~20 identical 409s in 100s until manually fixed. This is the same failure shape as the 2026-05-27 incident (9,567 claim errors over 7h); commit ab66a3c fixed the FM/dispatcher side (circuit breaker + cooldown) but not the worker claim retry. Fix: per-task claim backoff + skip-after-N with a single summary log.
issues.resolution: Worker claim loop had no per-task backoff; claimBackoff map in daemon.ts:224-238 with skip gate (:845), reset on claim/poll-exit, threshold 3 / base 30s / cap 5min, one summary log per escalation. Test with injected clock. Verified live: one claim-failure line total in the M1 run.

issues.title: Device agentId is registration-only and authoritative for claims; FORGE_DAEMON_AGENT_ID env looks authoritative but is not
issues.detail: Claim eligibility uses the DEVICE ROW's agentId (tasks.ts:794-799), set only at POST /devices; PATCH /devices/:id silently drops an agentId field (observed live - response returned agentId:null after sending agentId:architect). The daemon env FORGE_DAEMON_AGENT_ID only picks the spawn personality. A device registered without agentId can never claim FM-routed tasks and there is no error pointing at the mismatch. Fix: allow agentId update via PATCH (or reject unknown fields loudly), and log a startup warning when daemon env agentId differs from the device row (GET /devices/me).
issues.resolution: Hub: PatchDeviceBodySchema (routes/devices.ts) now makes name optional and accepts agentId (nullable); resolveDeviceAgentId validates against builtin registry or owned workspace-agent names, unknown id -> 422 unknown_agent, null clears; PATCH response reflects the update. Added GET /devices/me (device auth) returning own row. Note: the live symptom (silent drop) partially mismatched code archaeology - old RenameDeviceBodySchema required name, so agentId-only PATCH 400d; both failure modes now closed. Daemon: HubClient.getSelf() + warnIfAgentIdMismatchesDeviceRow() at startup logs a loud warning naming env vs device-row agentId when FORGE_DAEMON_AGENT_ID is set and differs (non-fatal, silent if unset, degrades gracefully if route missing). Tests: devices.test.ts PATCH updates/rejects-unknown/clears agentId + GET /devices/me 200/401; daemon-dispatch-fixes.test.ts issue-47 describe block (5 tests).

issues.title: FM synthetic-task done instruction still uses a relative .forge path
issues.detail: daemon.ts ~line 771: the dispatcher synthetic task done instruction uses relative .forge/tasks/<id>.done - same exposure as issue 3 if the FM personality ever re-resolves its root. Low risk (FM prompt has no repository-root language) but should use the absolute path for consistency. Spotted during the issue-3 fix.

issues.title: repo.test.ts real-git checkout test flakes under parallel turbo run (5s timeout + Windows EBUSY cleanup)
issues.detail: forge-daemon src/git/repo.test.ts (defaultGitOps.checkout, does NOT persist the token) timed out at 5000ms during a root pnpm test (all packages parallel) then EBUSY on temp-dir rmdir; passes in isolation (172/172 twice). Real git under contention needs a longer per-test timeout and retry-tolerant temp cleanup on Windows. UPDATE 2026-07-08: worker-loop/loop.test.ts (applies exponential backoff on poll errors) also failed once under parallel root pnpm test and passed twice in isolation; the flake family is parallel-load timing, not just real-git EBUSY.

issues.title: CD builds docker images ON the production host; M1 deploy build wedged accserver (services unresponsive, runner died mid-job)
issues.detail: CD run 28907394605 (M1 push, 2026-07-08 00:03Z): self-hosted runner on accserver died during step 4 Build and deploy all services - job marked failure with the step still in_progress and no logs uploaded. Aftermath: host pings and ports 22/443 accept TCP, but sshd banner exchange and TLS handshakes time out for 30s+ - the box is alive but crushed (or docker/sshd wedged). Production containers, the runner, and the image builds all share one host, so a heavy multi-image rebuild can take down prod AND the deploy mechanism AND remote access simultaneously. Deploy state is unknown/partial. Fix options: build images in CI (GHCR) and have accserver only pull+up; or hard resource-limit the build (nice/ionice, docker build --memory/--cpu-quota); plus a runner watchdog. Needs Adam for the immediate recovery (console access, likely reboot). UPDATE 2026-07-08: fix implemented (cd.yml build job on ubuntu-latest pushing 5 images to ghcr.io/sugar-crash-studios with :latest and :short-sha, deploy job pull-only with --no-build; compose files point at GHCR with IMAGE_TAG). Compose config validated locally; stays in-progress until the first live GHCR CD run proves auth/pull. Second wedge occurred same day (M2 push 93e1ff1): runner died mid-build again, box unreachable 30+ min.

issues.title: Residual null-vs-omit traps on low-traffic creation fields (comments.authorId, agent-instances.runtimeInstanceId, invites, agents.config)
issues.detail: Issue 29 fixed the public workspace/goal creation boundaries. Deliberately skipped: comments.ts CreateCommentInputSchema.authorId (device/system callers), agent-instances.ts runtimeInstanceId (device-auth daemon path), invites.ts fields (admin-only, null semantics ambiguous, needs product decision), agents.ts config (JSON blob, null means something different). Only worth fixing if a real client is observed sending null there.

issues.title: resolveDeviceAgentId validates workspace-agent names only against workspaces the user OWNS, not ones they are a member of
issues.detail: PATCH /devices/:id agentId validation (issue 47 fix) mirrors resolveAssignAgentId ownership precedent. A collaborator registering a device against another owner workspace-agent name gets 422 unknown_agent. Enhancement, not a bug; revisit with the members/invites work (M6 issue 26).

issues.title: GitHub reports 18 dependabot vulnerabilities on main (6 critical, 2 high, 9 moderate, 1 low)
issues.detail: Surfaced in the push output for the M2 push (93e1ff1, 2026-07-08). Triage at https://github.com/sugar-crash-studios/forge-lab/security/dependabot. Needs an audit pass: which are runtime deps in shipped images vs dev-only, then targeted bumps. Fits M5 security scope.

issues.title: Live-looking ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in the dev shell ambient environment; leaked once into a session transcript via docker compose config interpolation
issues.detail: Found 2026-07-08 during M3 infra work: docker compose gives shell env precedence over --env-file, so the ambient key was substituted into compose config output in an agent transcript. Action: verify whether the key is live, rotate if so, and remove the global export from the dev shell profile (scope it to the process that needs it). Related to the standing key-hygiene items (disabled forge-lab-workers key, gho_ token).

issues.title: migrate.ts splitStatements naively splits on semicolons inside SQL comments; comment-only fragments crash libsql
issues.detail: Found during M3 (0018_task_lease): a semicolon inside a -- comment produced a comment-only statement fragment that crashed the migration runner with SQLITE_UNKNOWN_0. Worked around by rewording the comment. Latent trap for every future migration author. Fix: strip comments before splitting or use a real SQL statement splitter, with a failing-first test using a semicolon-in-comment migration.
